Even though I don’t always agree with our elected officials, I have said the same thing as @JoaquinCastrotx many times over the years. After battling stage 4 cancer myself, I not only experienced medical debt first-hand, but witnessed others struggle as well. This is not a party issue, it is a humanity issue. Cancer is unbiased. It does not care about someone’s background, race, income, education, or political affiliation. It strikes quickly and without remorse. It is time for our government to address the issues in our healthcare system and create more affordable access to treatment. Political leaders need to unite in order to fix this very solvable problem. No one should have to forgo the treatment they need to fight cancer because of the cost.
